instruction: Write an ES module math.js exporting add and mul as named exports, and a main.js importing and using them.
Write a JavaScript module default-exporting a Config class, and consumer code importing it under a different name.
Write a JavaScript class Queue using private field #items with enqueue, dequeue and size, throwing on empty dequeue.
Write a JavaScript class Animal with a constructor and speak, and a Dog subclass that overrides speak and calls super in its constructor.
Write a JavaScript class StringUtils with static methods reverse(s) and isPalindrome(s).
Write a JavaScript class Temperature with a getter celsius and setter celsius that keeps a private _fahrenheit in sync, plus a static freezing constant.
Write a JavaScript EventEmitter class implementing on, off and emit with a private handlers map.
Write a TypeScript abstract class Shape with abstract area() and a concrete describe() that calls area, plus a Rectangle implementation.
Write JavaScript code showing named versus default exports: a utils.js with one named and one default export, and an importer using both.
Write a JavaScript barrel module index.js that re-exports everything from two modules, and consumer code importing from the barrel.
Write a JavaScript singleton module counter.js whose state is shared by every importer, plus two consumer modules that increment it.
Write a TypeScript class Database with a private constructor and a static connect() factory returning the instance (singleton).
Write a JavaScript class Logger with a fluent API where each method returns this so calls can chain: logger.level("info").tag("app").write("msg").
Write JavaScript code contrasting class field declarations initialized inline versus assigning in the constructor, including calling a method before fields initialize (use-before-init trap).
Write JavaScript code using dynamic import() to load a module lazily inside a function, with error handling.
Write JavaScript code importing a module namespace with import * as and calling one of its functions.
Write a JavaScript class SearchIndex where the onSearch callback is stored as an arrow class field so this stays bound when the callback is passed elsewhere.
Write a TypeScript class PaymentProcessor using composition: it holds a Logger instance and delegates logging in each method.
Write JavaScript code defining a class with a static initialization block that precomputes a lookup table used by instance methods.
Write a JavaScript mixin function applyMixin(Base) returning a subclass with an extra speak() method, demonstrating mixin-based reuse instead of inheritance chains.
